name: EndQuote SaaS MVP
objective: Track the six approved EndQuote MVP gates and final reviews without changing the approved plan, preserved experiences, or deployment scope.
exit_criteria: All six approved plan gates have recorded evidence, with no new preservation drift.
Real PostgreSQL fresh and upgrade migrations, private S3 and isolated restore, and packaged same-origin desktop/mobile E2E pass; absent dependencies are reported as blocked, not skipped passes.
Final code, security, and docs reviews are scheduled by the orchestrator after convergence, and blocking findings are resolved before sign-off. No deployment.
